user_query: I'm a music producer and I'm looking for inspiration for my next track. Can you provide me with the forecasted solar radiation data for the next week at my location? Additionally, give me the first-guess PV power output forecast based on my latitude, longitude, and PV system characteristics.

TaskList.description: Fetch the forecasted solar radiation data for the next week based on user location coordinates.
Calculate the first-guess PV power output forecast using the provided solar radiation data and PV system characteristics.
